description: Figure 1 presents a line plot comparing the loss performance of two models: Vanilla Transformer (represented by a purple line with circular markers) and the proposed SepLLM (represented by a red line with square markers) across varying computational costs. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 1.25, with tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and also uses a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. Both lines show a general downward trend as TFLOPs increase, indicating decreasing loss. The Vanilla Transformer line starts at a loss of approximately 2.75 and ends at approximately 2.50. The SepLLM line starts at a loss of approximately 2.70 and ends at approximately 2.45. A green dashed box highlights a region of the plot where the SepLLM line is consistently below the Vanilla Transformer line, with a label "1.28x" indicating a factor of 1.28 times lower loss for SepLLM compared to Vanilla Transformer at the point where the box ends.
